essence: The practitioner should take the required substance there after worshipping the goddess.
After applying collyrium to the eyes, one should then perform the prescribed applications.
If Bhairava does not properly manifest, the procedure is not successful.
If the desired manifestation fails, there is nothing further to be said.
The great mantras together with their secrets bestow success in the Kali age.
